description:
DEFERRED from stoa--h2z per PRINCIPAL HS-1 = Option 1 (2026-06-04). Tier-1 (discipline + pattern, op-disc §36) ships in the round; this Tier-2 is its own arc/team in the debloat-via-workflows initiative.

SCOPE: author + battle-test the executable /defeat-threat workflow. Substantial because: (1) a workflow forbids mid-run human input, so the gauntlet HARD STOP forces a STAGE-SPLIT — Stage A (STRABO->DAEDALUS->ARGUS) -> human ratify -> Stage B (ADA->VERA->CATO); each stage is its own saved workflow per the docs. (2) per-agent schemas (verdict typed returns). (3) args parameterization (Run /defeat-threat on M<n>). (4) success criterion = threat_coverage.defeats_via_probe in probes_executed (the yfv.1 keystone). (5) battle-test on a real threat before canon.

DEPLOY IS BUILT-IN (verified vs https://code.claude.com/docs/en/workflows): save to .claude/workflows/ via /workflows 's'; auto-discovered as /<name>; no registry. install.sh optional one-line copy for consumer propagation.

ROLE IN THE INITIATIVE: this is the PROOF-OF-CONCEPT first workflow of the debloat-via-workflows plan (encode process-disciplines as enforcing workflows). Lessons generalize. To be planned with the PRINCIPAL alongside the broader debloat + release-cycle work. Cross-ref stoa--h2z (design), stoa--04n (composer skill), stoa--ikr (round).
title: Tier-2: /defeat-threat executable workflow — first arc of debloat-via-workflows initiative (deferred from h2z)
